seed_provenance.description: Lazy catalog weights: conditional probabilities at every level. Package nodes proportional to 30-day PyPI download counts; a package absent from the census gets the minimum present count (66310); classes uniform within a package; every level normalized. Family nodes keep the sibling convention weight 0.3, so the top level is uniform across the eight families. The previous v0 pypistats provenance applied to the replaced hand-written tool leaves and lives in git history.
